name: Tsukiji Food Tour w/ Ali (meet point)
notes: Airbnb Experience 6919404 — ~2hr, from $32/pp, food not included, bring cash. Book 7 AM slot early in trip. Itinerary already hits Tsukiji (Tokyo #5). https://www.airbnb.com/experiences/6919404

name: Zauo Shibuya
notes: Catch-your-own-fish restaurant. Reserve ahead for evenings. Space apart from Tsukiji.

name: Yakiniku Coco Nemaru Ginza
notes: Wagyu yakiniku (grill at table). Ask for a private room. 1 min from Ginza Stn Exit C3.

name: Katsudon-ya Zuicho
notes: One-dish katsudon spot, ~8 seats, expect a line. Closed Sundays.

name: Omoide Yokocho (Memory Lane)
notes: Yakitori alley by Shinjuku Stn. Already on the itinerary (Tokyo #11).

name: The SG Club
notes: Top cocktail bar, Shibuya. Opens 6 PM. Nightcap spot.

name: Sushi Punch
notes: Omakase sushi, Azabujuban 7F. Book ahead. Closed Sundays.

name: Yoroniku Ebisu
notes: Wagyu yakiniku omakase. Reservation-only, book ~1 month out. Overlaps w/ Coco Nemaru — pick one.

name: Uonami Fish Bar
notes: Retro izakaya, Toshima. Out of the way + seafood overlap — low priority. Closed Mondays.

name: Good Wood Terrace
notes: Caribbean jerk chicken, Shibuya (viral after Kanye). Novelty pick. 2-19-3 Dogenzaka.

name: MixTHINKS Harajuku
notes: Vintage designer bags. Ask condition grade (N/S/A/AB/B). Bring passport for tax-free.

name: Momotaro Jeans Aoyama
notes: Japanese selvedge denim. Free hemming; can be a wait. Ask about shrinkage.

name: Nishikawa Sleep Navi — Matsuya Ginza
notes: Custom-fit pillow. Walk-ins OK; ~20-30 min fitting + ~40 min make. Gift idea for mom.

name: Nishikawa — Nihonbashi (alt)
notes: Alt custom pillow location. Reservations available online.

name: Sagano Romantic Train — Saga Torokko Stn
notes: Peak fall leaves late Nov. Book exactly 1 month out; Car No. 5 open-air; right side (AB seats). Pair w/ Arashiyama.

name: Taiga Takahashi (T.T)
notes: Vintage-inspired workwear in a Gion machiya. 12-7 PM daily.

name: KUOE Kyoto (optional)
notes: Build-your-own watch. Optional — B.B. Garage is the priority watch stop. Closed Tue.

name: B.B. Garage (Amerikamura)
notes: Vintage watches + Americana. 12-8 PM, closed Wed. Ask about overhaul/warranty + original parts.

name: Sennichimae Doguyasuji
notes: Kitchenware street — knives (engraving), fake food. 10 AM-6 PM. Go before Amemura opens.
